result.question: Qual a evolução anual da taxa de mortalidade por estado (MA e RS)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT mu.estado, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mu.estado, ano ORDER BY mu.estado, ano;
result.generated_sql: SELECT sub."estado", sub."ano", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sub."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "taxa_mortalidade" FROM ( SELECT mu."estado", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS "ano", i."MORTE", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mu."estado", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM "internacoes" i JOIN "municipios" mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu."estado", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER"), i."MORTE" ) sub WHERE sub.rn = 1 GROUP BY sub."estado", sub."ano" ORDER BY sub."estado", sub."ano";
